content.text: The brute force materializes too many layouts. Let me make it lazy with an early abort and cap R≤4 for full exhaustive checks:

cd /workspace/tmp/tests && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
src = open('brutelib.py').read()
old = """def brute(starts, bursts, C, hit, miss, dec):
    \"\"\"All layouts for one version; returns dict resident -> (work,pages) lex-min
    plus full option list for cross-checking the combine.\"\"\"
    R = len(starts)
    Q, T = q_t(starts, bursts)
"""
new = """class TooBig(Exception):
    pass


def brute(starts, bursts, C, hit, miss, dec, limit=300000):
    \"\"\"All layouts for one version; returns dict resident -> (work,pages) lex-min
    plus full option list for cross-checking the combine.\"\"\"
    R = len(starts)
    Q, T = q_t(starts, bursts)
    budget = [limit]
"""
src = src.replace(old, new)
src = src.replace("""                    for combo in itertools.product(*subs):
                                work = base + sum(c[0] for c in combo)""",
"""                    for combo in itertools.product(*subs):
                                budget[0] -= 1
                                if budget[0] < 0:
                                    raise TooBig
                                work = base + sum(c[0] for c in combo)""")
open('brutelib.py','w').write(src)
PYEOF
grep -n "budget\[0\]" brutelib.py | head
